card.name: Inside interleukin and other long names
card.fires_on: The word piece "in" ending "interleukin" just before a hyphen and number, as in interleukin-1 or -2. Also fires partway through other long names like immunoglobulins, Tuscany or Abdallah.

modes.label: Interleukin before hyphen
modes.description: The ending "in" of interleukin right before -1 or -2.
modes.example: Concurrent use of anakinra (an interleuk<<in>>-1 antagonist) and another TNF

modes.label: Other split long names
modes.description: Middle of a long medical term or a place or personal name.
modes.example: In 1559 the grand duke of T<<usc>>any, Cosimo I de’ Med

card.writes: It promotes odd word-piece tokens and suppresses spaces, newlines and small linking words, so it favors continuing the word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long names, most clearly in the word interleukin before a hyphen and number.
